QuestInfo.name: Siren Sirin
QuestInfo.0: Aldin seemed sad. Alpha and Beta decided to see what was wrong.
QuestInfo.1: Aldin tells you that he has been in love with the pretty dancer named Sirin for a while but he hasn't been able to talk to her once because he is shy. Go get #r#t4000936##k for Aldin so that he can see the beautiful Sirin up close.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta got Telescopes for Aldin, so that he could marvel at Sirin's beauty from afar. Not creepy at all.

0.0: Oh, beauteous Sirin! You shine brighter than the stars! You quench my thirst more than a desert oasis! I would walk through the hot sands barefoot, if only I could see your beauty up close!
0.1: I probably look like an idiot to you... Love makes people do dumb things! I can't even bear to look her in the eye without being blinded by her beauty! I can't imagine how beautiful she would look from up close... Will you help me?

yes.0: Actually, I CAN see Sirin better. All I need is a #r#t4000936##k! Bring me 15, would you?

no.0: If I don't see her, I'll wilt like a flower without water...

yes.0: This Telescope is really going to increase my Sirin-watching abilities tenfold! I hope I don't go blind...

default.0: If only I had some #r#t4000936##k items, I could spy on, I mean, look at Sirin all day long.
